about: Authored in canopy (tests/canopy_mcp/fixtures/workspace/); every other holder keeps a byte-identical copy of the whole directory.
ASCII-only, no trailing whitespace, exactly one final newline.

args: the closed argument set (the hub refuses anything else as invalid_command). extras: the applied result's extra fields. destructive: whether an applied changed:true command pushes a group on the closed-tabs stack.
Each case runs in context.json's context (with the case's context keys replaced whole): command {cmd, args} -> result, the command's result entry without its id.
after, when present: the open tab keys in strip order and the active key once the command is applied.
A no-op is applied {changed: false}; a destructive no-op pushes no group and carries no group extra.
A collection opened with its layout (as layout, or no as on a collection that has one) pushes a layout group.

args.as: tabs | side | layout, optional (default: its saved layout, else side)

cases.name: open_collection without as opens a layout-less collection side by side
open_collection without as uses the saved layout and pushes a layout group
open_collection as tabs opens the members as tabs of one tile
